def VTask.prev {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α) (h : x ∈ l) : α :=
match l with
| [] => absurd h (not_mem_nil _)
| [_] => x
| y :: ys =>
  match ys with
  | [] => y
  | z :: zs =>
    if h then
      if x == y then z
      else prev (z :: zs) x h
    else x
